text: The service here is excellent. The doctor is skilled and kind. He examines thoroughly and prescribes only necessary medications. I already have old medications, so the doctor checked which ones I could continue taking and which ones I should stop taking, then prescribed additional medications that I needed. I'm glad I decided to come to this clinic. It's fast and thorough. I personally feel it's better than sitting sick and waiting in the hospital because coming here saves me a lot of money and time.
